A '''[[Syndicat]] armor coat''' was a coat worn by the guards of the [[Syndicat]], a criminal organization that controlled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]] during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The armor included a coat and visor. The only spots that the armor did not protect were the neck and wrists, which [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] exploited in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].
